name: FortiWeb — Encoded SQL Injection Attempt
description: Fires on encoded, comment-bypass, and time-based-blind SQL-injection patterns seen by FortiWeb across the request URL, user-agent, and body — time-based payloads (sleep(n)/pg_sleep/benchmark/waitfor), comment-obfuscated keywords (sel/**/ect), hex/union selects, and file/OS primitives (load_file/into outfile/xp_cmdshell). These indicate active exploitation attempts against public-facing banking apps. The rule lower-cases and concatenates URL+UA+body and regex-matches with numeric-argument gating to limit false positives. Maps to ATT&CK Initial Access T1190 (Exploit Public-Facing Application).
note:
### Investigation
1. Read data.http_url (and the UA/body surface) to see the actual injection payload and which SQLi class it is.
2. Check data.http_retcode and response timing — a 200 or a delayed response on a time-based payload suggests the injection worked.
3. Identify the source (data.original_src) and target app (data.http_host); external unknown source against a sensitive app raises priority.
4. Correlate with SQL Server audit alerts (xp_cmdshell/OLE, idx53/63) on the backing database for a successful pivot.
5. Escalate on evidence of success (timing/retcode) or corroborating DB-side execution.

### False positives / benign
Rare application or CAD traffic can contain literal sleep(...) substrings that match without being attacks. Distinguish by the surrounding syntax (the numeric-argument gate already filters bare words), whether multiple SQLi patterns co-occur, the response code/timing, and whether the source is a legitimate app client versus an external scanner. Investigate the payload rather than allowlisting the source or path, which an attacker can vary.

### Notes
Investigation fields corrected to data.original_src (99% populated) vs the deployed query gate data.src; the query-level field fix is deferred to a validated Batch-2 change (unvalidated logic not deployed here). When the payload sits in UA/body, http_url is blank — surface the matched surface.
false_positives: Graphics/CAD apps with literal `sleep(...)` substring — rare;
Internal pentest from inside the network — exclude internal IPs at
query:
FROM logs-* METADATA _id, _version, _index
| WHERE  @timestamp >= NOW() - 30 minutes
  AND data.src IS NOT NULL
| EVAL u  = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(data.http_url, ""))
| EVAL ua = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(data.http_agent, ""))
| EVAL b  = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(data.packet.packet, ""))
| EVAL surf = CONCAT(u, " | ", ua, " | ", b)
| WHERE
        /* Time-based blind, REQUIRE numeric arg to limit FP */
        surf RLIKE "(?s).*sleep\\([0-9]+\\).*"
    OR surf RLIKE ".*pg_sleep\\([0-9]+\\).*"
    OR surf RLIKE ".*benchmark\\([0-9]+,.*"
    OR surf RLIKE ".*dbms_pipe\\.receive_message\\(.*"
    OR surf LIKE "*waitfor*delay*"
    /* Comment / case-mutation bypass */
    OR surf LIKE "*/*!*select*"
    OR surf LIKE "*sel/**/ect*"
    OR surf LIKE "*un/**/ion*"
    OR surf LIKE "*sel%65ct*"
    OR surf LIKE "*%75nion*"
    /* Data-extraction primitives */
    OR surf LIKE "*concat(0x*"
    OR surf LIKE "*group_concat(*"
    OR surf LIKE "*load_file(*"
    OR surf LIKE "*into outfile*"
    OR surf LIKE "*xp_dirtree*"
    OR surf LIKE "*xp_cmdshell*"
    /* Hex-encoded keywords */
    OR surf LIKE "*0x73656c656374*"   /* hex 'select' */
    OR surf LIKE "*0x756e696f6e*"      /* hex 'union' */
| KEEP _id, _index, @timestamp, data.src, data.http_method, data.http_url,
       data.http_agent, data.http_retcode 
| LIMIT 200
